name: Backtrade
steps: Use only backtrade.xyz , its app, docs and partners subdomains, and @backtrade_xyz on X.

Press Join waitlist and enter a wallet address and an email. The form can answer "Not available in your region." and no country list is published. Warning The form takes your email, but the docs say: "The terms, privacy policy and risk disclosure are being prepared with counsel and are not published yet."
Deposit at least 10 USDC, counted after fees, from Hyperliquid or HyperEVM. A first deposit to an unused address also pays a one-time 1 USDC activation.
Pick BTC or ETH, long or short, from $10 of margin. Warning At 1000x on BTC, "a move of about 0.052% against you liquidates the position, and the whole margin is lost".
Losses mint BACK by themselves. Claim its USDC in the app, and withdraw your free balance at any time (at least 10 USDC through the app).
what: Backtrade's docs rule out an airdrop. BACK is minted only when you lose on its 1000x HyperEVM perps and burns in 7 days. Waitlist only; not live yet.
behind: Backtrade names nobody. We found no person, company or investor on its site, partner page or docs, which mention only "the team" and multisig wallets. No raise is published, and the pool was not seeded. The domain was registered on 9 December 2025. Nothing official links Backtrade to Papertrade's developers, and neither project mentions the other. Opening a trade costs nothing, and "Everything the protocol takes comes out of a winning close": a deadband, a haircut that keeps at most 90% of the gain, a 2% win fee and a 1.2% referral fee. "The contracts are upgradeable, so in principle the owner can make them do anything", after a 1-day delay.
